definitions.explanation: A strong prohibition, often seen on signs and in rules. Stronger than 禁止, conveying zero tolerance.

examples.japanese: {撮影|さつえい}{厳禁|げんきん}。
この{地域|ちいき}では{火気|かき}の{使用|しよう}が{厳禁|げんきん}されている。
examples.english: The use of open flames is strictly prohibited in this area.

examples.japanese: {関係者|かんけいしゃ}{以外|いがい}の{立|た}ち{入|い}りは{厳禁|げんきん}となっております。
examples.english: Entry is strictly prohibited for anyone other than authorized personnel.

notes: Commonly appears on signs in the pattern 〜{厳禁|げんきん}: {飲酒|いんしゅ}{厳禁|げんきん} (alcohol strictly forbidden), {喫煙|きつえん}{厳禁|げんきん} (smoking strictly forbidden). Stronger than {禁止|きんし} (prohibited), which is a standard prohibition. {厳禁|げんきん} implies severe consequences for violations. Not the same as the homophone {現金|げんきん} (cash).
